name: Improved Smite
body:
Your righteousness brings down those who oppose you.

Prerequisite(s): Base attack bonus +3, Smite Evil

Benefit: Your smite ability deals +1d6 holy damage for every three levels in the pertinent class. Example: A 3rd level paladin deals +1d6 damage, while a 10th level one deals +3d6.
